title: Above terrain
goal: Plan a flight above terrain and fly it, keeping at least 20 m over the ground.

steps.text: Plan a flight to the far ring and back at 30 m above terrain, then upload it.
steps.hint: Choose Above terrain for the plan. Try Above home first and look at the Profile tab: where the ground rises, the line comes close to it.

steps.text: Switch to Auto and fly it out to the far ring.
Let it fly back and land.

fails.says: Failed. It came within 20 m of the ground. Above terrain keeps the height over the ground; check the profile before you fly.

passed: Passed. It kept 20 m or more over the ground all the way.
